text:
Maya: Quick heads-up: planning a small release at 22:00 UTC — runtime v2.4.1 (kernel batching + eviction tuning) + router header rename (old: X-RW-ID -> new: X-Redwood). Need API to accept both headers for a short overlap, and Console to keep ui-schema pinned. Any blockers?

Sam: API 👍. I'll add accept list for headers and a short-lived compatibility shim to rewrite X-Redwood -> X-RW-ID for downstreams. ETA ~10m. Can we gate the router flip behind a feature flag? @Leo can console show both header variants during rollout? :eyes:

Cheng: Runtime note: v2.4.1 changes KV eviction thresholds which can increase eviction churn briefly on hotspots. Recommend 3-phase canary: 3% for 10m, 25% for 10m, then full. Watch kv.evictions/sec, kv.hit_ratio, and cold-start p99. If evictions +35% or errors >0.4% cut immediately.

DeployBot: Canary initiated — runtime v2.4.1 deployed to shard s-21, canary=3%. Auto-rollback conditions configured: errors > 0.4% for 4m OR p95 > baseline * 1.25 for 4m. Alert channel: #eng-oncall.

Leo: Console will pin ui-schema v1.8.2 for the window and expose a runtime header toggle behind env var CONSOLE_HEADER_MIGRATE. I'll add a quick admin toggle so support can flip if needed.

Anita: Oncall here. Adding temporary alerts: p95, p99, error-rate, kv.evictions. Also ensure request header is logged (both variants) for any 5xxs. If alert fires, page SRE and prepare rollback steps.

Sam: Pushing API change now. Config snippet:
```
api.accept_headers: ["X-RW-ID", "X-Redwood"]
compat_middleware: enabled
canary.windows: [600, 600]
```
Deploy command I'll run: `deploybot deploy runtime v2.4.1 --canary 3 --shard s-21`

Maya: Rollback short-playbook:
- `deploybot rollback runtime v2.4.1 --to v2.4.0 --immediate`
- Console: keep ui-schema pinned until manual verification
- API: disable compat_middleware and revert header acceptance
- Run quick postmortem if outage > 30m

DeployBot: Canary metrics @ +2m: errors=0.12%, p95 +9% vs baseline, kv.evictions steady. No auto-roll triggered.

Cheng: Good. I'll tail eviction logs for top-20 keys and watch hit_ratio. If eviction/sec rises rapidly we stop ramp.

Leo: Admin toggle and UI pin are live. PR: https://git.internal/repo/PR-321 (will post in thread).

Anita: Dashboards up and alerts wired to PagerDuty. Logging includes header snapshots for 5xx.

DeployBot: Canary moved to 25% per schedule. Monitoring window: 10m.

Sam: Compat shim will auto-disable after 15m post-full-roll. Leaving it on for the overlap window.

Cheng: Canary @ +18m — no KV anomalies, cold-starts unchanged. p99 flat. Proceed with full rollout at +5m if no alerts.

Anita: No pages so far. p95 trending slightly but within configured limit.

Maya: OK let's reconvene at 22:25UTC here. If anything trips, run rollback steps. Otherwise, we finish the flip and retire compat shim after 15m post-cut.
